create_coefficient_mapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to manage spherical harmonic coefficient indices for given lmax and mmax values
get_coefficient_indices: get coefficient indices less than or equal to a specified degree l and order m using coefficient_idx
compute_complex_indices: compute real and imaginary part indices for a given order m using the complex_idx method
transform_irreps_to_grid: transform an irreps embedding tensor into a grid representation on SO3 using the to_grid method
transform_grid_to_irreps: transform a grid representation tensor back into irreps using the from_grid method
